data.summary: Make [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage] on generated code opt-out via GeneratedMessagePackResolver(ExcludeFromCodeCoverage = false), default true; composite resolvers still always get it.
data.quote_supporting_both: I would like all generated code to be decorated with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute.  I do not feel like a setting is needed, but setting would be fine to have too.
